activity_summary: The leaf was as you had left it. The Prince was in the square, with no speech. Cords, and a ladder of rope, and nothing written under them. You added nothing. No player was named in the margin.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the four lines, and put the stylus down.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Mentioned in The leaf still standing

facets.activity: Read the leaf as it stood
